page.overview:
Who is Alonzo Freeman?

Admiral Alonzo "'Zo" Freeman was a male Human Starfleet Command flag officer who lived and served during the late 24th century.

In 2380, he was in communication with wife, Captain Carol Freeman of the . Their relationship appeared to be strained as a result of the questionable conduct of their daughter, Ensign Beckett Mariner. ()

The following year, Freeman informed his wife that "some important people" became impressed with Carol following her battle with the Pakleds, and that she could potentially be promoted to a capital ship, so long as she maintained a positive record. ()

Later that year, Captain Freeman reported to Admiral Freeman the resolution of the situation involving Ferengi poachers on Frylon IV. Afterward, Freeman warned her about a scam in the local sector, where a con artist would self-destruct their ship and attempt to pin it on Starfleet. ()
